Χ χ, χεῖ(q.v.),τό,indecl., twenty-second letter of the Gr. alphabet, Pl. Cra. 414b , Ti. 36b . As numeral,χ́ =
600 , x'
=
600 , 000 : but in Inscrr., X stands forχίλιοι,αι,α, =
1000 .

χά, exclamation representing laughter,
ha! ha!,
PMag.Leid.W. 4.33 .

χααναία,ἡ,
priest's robe,
J. AJ 3.7.1 (χαναίαςcodd.): a mistranslation of Aram.
kāh[acaron]nayyâ'priests'.

χαβίτια,τά, prob.
= χαβότια , PCair.Zen. 680.20
(iii B. C.).

χαβός,ή,όν,
= καμπύλος, στενός , Hsch. ; cf.χαμόν.

χάβος,ὁ,
= κημός , Sch. Ar. Eq. 1147 .

χαβότια,τά, dub. sens., perh.
honey-pots, PSI 4.428.53
(iii B. C.).
